d:
Itli ke rajneta aur yuropiy soshlist parti ke mahaschiv jiyakomo philibek ne haidrabad men aayojit 'bharat samit' karyakram men "vot chor, gaddi chhor" ka nara lagaya. is par bijepi ki or se kari aapatti jataee gaee hai. jiyakomo philibek ka bayan 14 navanbar 2026 ko aaya aur us vaqt karyakram men rahul gandhi aur any kangres neta bhi maujud the. bharat samit ka yah karyakram telangana rajy sarkar aur 'samriddh bharat phaundeshan' ne sanyukt rup se kiya tha.
Riport tim bibisi hindi
